evidence.quoted_text:
drain_items(config, groups, sorted(groups, key=priority))
    return result
evidence.reason: At the current tip, `drain()` discards the result of `drain_items(...)` at line 1030 and unconditionally returns `result` at line 1031, whose status was initialized to `drained` and is only changed on the pre-admission queue-read failure. The existing queue-unreadable path explicitly sets `status` to `error` so `run()` exits non-zero; worker failures after admission have no equivalent propagation. Thus a forked worker failure can still be reported as a successful drained run and cannot be distinguished from an intentional admission stop. This is an ordinary correctness defect; the existing triage field should be preserved.
